<span class="hl-kw">package</span> com.solo.events.domain.aggregate;

<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>;
<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">Map</span>;

<span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">record</span> UnknownEventData(
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> status,
    <span class="hl-type">Integer</span> level,
    <span class="hl-type">Object</span> mode,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> kind,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> version,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> flag
) {

    <span class="hl-comment">@SuppressWarnings</span>(<span class="hl-str">&quot;unchecked&quot;</span>)
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> UnknownEventData fromMap(<span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; map) {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> UnknownEventData(
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;status&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Integer</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;level&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Object</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;mode&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;kind&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;version&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;flag&quot;</span>)
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; toMap() {
        <span class="hl-kw">var</span> map = <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt;();
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;status&quot;</span>, status);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;level&quot;</span>, level);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;mode&quot;</span>, mode);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;kind&quot;</span>, kind);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;version&quot;</span>, version);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;flag&quot;</span>, flag);
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> map;
    }
}
